delivery.en: Arrange collection with Grenada Postal Corporation, or use one of their local parcel locations
delivery.zh: 可向格瑞那達郵政預約取件，或到他們的當地包裹點領

readback.en: Read a 473 number as 3-3-4; 0 as zero; East Caribbean dollars; 12-hour time, day then month
readback.zh: 473 號碼按 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；金額用東加勒比元；12 時制，先日後月

fraud.en: A social-media investment ad that shifts you to WhatsApp and promises guaranteed returns is a scam
fraud.zh: 社群廣告談投資，再把你拉到 WhatsApp 或 Telegram，並保證穩賺，都是詐騙

habits.en: Good afternoon with strangers. Say mobile, not cell. Money is in East Caribbean dollars. Day before month.
habits.zh: 對生人說 Good afternoon。說 mobile 不說 cell。貨幣是東加勒比元。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: I was about to book a Grenada Postal Corporation collection, and the bank app will not open.
stall_local.zh: 正要向格瑞那達郵政預約取件，銀行 App 卻打不開。

reason.zh: 美國包裹櫃；格瑞那達郵政寫的是預約取件與當地包裹點
美國轉帳品牌，不是格瑞那達投資或銀行的慣用詞
美國健保，不宜套進本地電話
美式用語，當地較常說 mobile

talk_style_diff.en: Keep a polite, unhurried tone with strangers. Use Grenada Postal Corporation and East Caribbean dollar wording; do not echo US tax, Medicare or locker scripts.
talk_style_diff.zh: 對生人保持客氣、不趕。用格瑞那達郵政與東加勒比元，不要跟著說美國稅務、Medicare 或包裹櫃。

uncertain: 上門投遞有多常見，郵政網站主打預約取件與包裹點，沒有全國比例。
電話裡投資詐騙與社群廣告哪個較多，CSIRT 文主寫社群與即時通。
